utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Morning all, you alright? Let's get cracking, quick stand-up for Friday 13 March.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Morning. Barely, to be honest, traffic on the ring road was awful. Proper crawling all the way in.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah same sort of vibe coming in. Anyway, er, who's bringing stuff for the charity bake sale on Friday? My missus has gone a bit mad with brownies.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Brownies'll go. As long as no one leaves them in the control room again.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Morning all. Right, let's try and keep sugar and machinery separate, please.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yeah, fair. Okay, updates first. Callum?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Production-wise we're okay on lines 1 and 2. Line 3, still waiting on parts for the line 3 screw, nothing we can do until they arrive, so that's still just parked.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yep, blocked then, leave that where it is for now.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: From me, I tested the water booster yesterday and it's all fine now, so that's done. And, um, we were going to replace the belt on the Boiler Safety Relief Valve but that's been pushed to next month so ignore it.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Good, so not for today then.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: I already swapped the filter on the dryer yesterday, so that's off the list as well.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Nice one, Dave.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: While I was over there I heard a slight rattle from the dryer, nothing to action yet, just worth keeping an ear on.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yeah, I didn't feel anything nasty through the frame, so probably just a bit of chatter.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Okay, observation only, no job off the back of it yet.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: I also saw the pressure on the wrapper dip for a few minutes, it came back on its own, so again I haven't touched it.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Didn't hit output, that one, so fine for now.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Right. Anything urgent-urgent before we do actions?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Nothing from HSE, just the usual permits look clean.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Good. Priya, anything else?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: No, that's me really. Electrical's quiet unless something falls over.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Lovely. Fiona?

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Planner side, I've got a couple I can pick up. If you've got a spare minute, I'll take vibration readings on the Gas Turbine 1 first thing tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yeah, okay, Fi taking that, noted.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: You sure you want that one? I can do it if you're stacked.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: No, it's alright, I'll do it. It's quick enough first thing tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Sound. That's agreed then.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: And the other one, the GT2 Inlet Water Injection Valve - the sensors are still drifting a bit. That needs doing this week, I'll recalibrate the sensors on the GT2 Inlet Water Injection Valve on the 3rd.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Makes sense. They've been a bit ropey on the trend.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yep, Fiona Doyle to do that on the 3rd, good.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Just make sure if you're cracking that box open you've got the right isolation, please.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yeah, of course.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Anything mechanical we need to call out?

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Um, one thing hanging around: the booster pump. We've still got that pressure drop coming and going.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yeah.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: It's fairly important to investigate the pressure drop on the booster pump by the 28th, but I can't honestly take it with what I've got on.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Can anyone pick that up?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Not me, I'm tied up with the panel work.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: I've got controls jobs backed up already.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: No, I can't this side either.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Production can't spare anyone to help, sorry.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Right, leave it visible then: investigate the pressure drop on the booster pump by the 28th, fairly important, but nobody's taking it right now.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: As long as it's being watched in the meantime.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: We'll keep an eye on it from the floor.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Dave, anything from your side we need an owner on?

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yeah, the paperwork side more than spanners. The purchase order's still not landed for the big boiler.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Mm.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: That needs doing this week - I'll chase the purchase order for the big boiler on Friday.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Good shout, because stores were asking yesterday.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Dave's got it: chase the purchase order for the big boiler on Friday.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yep.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Right, one from me. Olu, can you run a function test on the line 1 mould temp today, top priority please?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah, alright. I'll run a function test on the line 1 mould temp.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Preferably before the long run starts, if you can.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll get on it early doors.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Cheers. That's top priority please.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: If you want a second pair of eyes on the IO while you're there, give us a shout.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Will do.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Any permits needed for that or is it just live test and verify?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Just live test and verify, no intrusive stuff.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Fine. Anything else that's actually for today, not nice-to-knows?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: No, shift cover's okay. Just don't all disappear at once.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: I'll be mostly in the office after rounds if anyone needs plans moving.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: I've got contractor call at ten, then I'm on the boiler bits.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: I've got to finish those cabinet drawings this morning.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: And apparently buy raffle tickets, by the sound of it.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: That's not going on the maintenance plan, Olu.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Worth a try.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Right, recap before we drop. Fi will take vibration readings on the Gas Turbine 1 first thing tomorrow, if you've got a spare minute.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yep.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Fiona Doyle will recalibrate the sensors on the GT2 Inlet Water Injection Valve on the 3rd; that needs doing this week.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Correct.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Booster pump pressure drop - fairly important, by the 28th, but no owner yet.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Sadly, yes.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Dave will chase the purchase order for the big boiler on Friday, needs doing this week.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yep, I'll do that on Friday.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: And Olu will run a function test on the line 1 mould temp, top priority please.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Accepted.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Nice one. Have a good one, all.
